_reservesOf[token] is set to token.balanceOf(this) before credit is capped by amountHint. Excess is absorbed into stored reserves and is not _supplyCredit-ed. The comment says the leftover is discarded from the credited amount. Later observation contract must keep reserve residue, caller credit, and tokenDelta distinct. Source inspection is not an EVM rollback proof.

Before-add hook can change balances/rates; reload precedes _addLiquidity. After-add false or wrong length reverts. If enableHookAdjustedAmounts is false, hook return amounts are ignored. A revert of the outer Solidity call is ordinary EVM rollback, not a proved P25 hook-revert accounting theorem.

Credit is negative tokenDelta, debt positive. Non-zero counter updates only on zero transitions. Outer unlock requires zero outstanding deltas then increments session. Nested unlock does not take that settle check. unlock calls msg.sender via functionCall under the modifier.
